Tune only after testing, in 0.1 mm steps."},"bolt_clearance":{"value":0.4,"kind":"design","source":"design","note":"Diametral clearance."},"beam_t":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"beam_root_x":{"value":-6.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"beam_tip_x":{"value":2.2,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_start_x":{"value":-6,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_end_x":{"value":3,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_inner_y":{"value":1.9,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"slot_outer_y":{"value":4.25,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lead_h":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"lead_relief":{"value":0.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"hex_entry_extra":{"value":0.8,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_count":{"value":12,"unit":"count","kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_radius":{"value":1.4,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"scallop_center_radius":{"value":10.5,"kind":"design","source":"design"},"coupon_d":{"value":16,"kind":"design","source":"design"}},"parts":[{"id":"knob","role":"final","material":"PLA","code":"def build(p):
    import math
    def hex_points(af):
        r=af/math.sqrt(3)
        return [(r*math.cos(i*math.pi/3),r*math.sin(i*math.pi/3)) for i in range(6)]
    body=cq.Workplane('XY').circle(p.knob_d/2).extrude(p.height)
    for i in range(int(p.scallop_count)):
        a=2*math.pi*i/p.scallop_count
        cutter=cq.Workplane('XY').center(p.scallop_center_radius*math.cos(a),p.scallop_center_radius*math.sin(a)).circle(p.scallop_radius).extrude(p.height)
        body=body.cut(cutter)
    af=p.nut_af+p.hex_clearance
    pocket=cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.floor).polyline(hex_points(af)).close().extrude(p.height-p.floor)
    entry=(cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=p.height-p.lead_h).polyline(hex_points(af)).close().workplane(offset=p.lead_h).polyline(hex_points(af+p.hex_entry_extra)).close().loft())
    body=body.cut(pocket).cut(entry)
    bore=cq.Workplane('XY').circle((p.bolt_d+p.bolt_clearance)/2).extrude(p.height)
    body=body.cut(bore)
    a=(p.nut_af-p.grip_interference)/2
    for s in [-1,1]:
        slot=(cq.Workplane('XY').center((p.slot_start_x+p.slot_end_x)/2,s*(p.slot_inner_y+p.slot_outer_y)/2).rect(p.slot_end_x-p.slot_start_x,p.slot_outer_y-p.slot_inner_y).extrude(p.height))
        body=body.cut(slot)
        profile=[(s*a,0),(s*(a+p.beam_t),0),(s*(a+p.beam_t),p.height),(s*(a+p.lead_relief),p.height),(s*a,p.height-p.lead_h)]
        beam=(cq.Workplane('YZ',origin=(p.beam_root_x,0,0)).polyline(profile).close().extrude(p.beam_tip_x-p.beam_root_x))
        body=body.union(beam)
    return body.clean()

Do not exceed 0.4 mm total interference. Stop and revise the fit if retention still fails or any spring cracks or whitens. The current 5.30 mm setting is unchanged because no fit result was available.","parts":["fit_coupon"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"4","text":"Recover the nut by threading the bolt into it from the underside and gently pushing it toward the open socket while supporting the coupon. Print knob using the successful setting and the same filament and slicer settings. Only knob is part of the finished assembly.","parts":["fit_coupon","knob"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"5","text":"Press nut into knob as tested; repeat the inversion and through-bolt checks. This knob captures the nut, not the bolt head.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]},{"n":"6","text":"Use light finger tightening only, with the workpiece against the underside so the nut bears on its shoulder. Stop if the nut spins or retention weakens. PLA can relax with time and heat: check retention before use and keep away from hot environments.","parts":["knob"],"hardware":["nut","bolt"]}]}
